\section{Word round trip}

A glossed example comes first.

\ex.\label{gl} \gll Das {kleine Kind} schl\"aft \\
     the {little child} sleep.\lpzg{3sg} \\
\glt `The little child sleeps.'

\ex.\label{par} As the grammars put it:
\a.\label{pa} *\gll Der Hund schlafen \\
     the dog sleep.\lpzg{inf} \\
\b.\label{pb} Der Hund schl\"aft.

\ex. que Pierre est fatigu\'e\exannot{[CP]}

See \ref{gl}, \pref{gl}, \ref{pa} and \ref{pb}.\footnote{A note referring to \ref{par}.}
